trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy on this list; the platinum arrives with the final one. One playthrough is enough, but there is no mission replay or New Game+, so preserve chapter-start saves and an untouched save before the final mission. Roadmap stage 7 — 100% and the platinum.
steps: Open the matching activity, map marker or character menu.
Complete the requirement in the official description.
Check the in-game completion list, then claim the final trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strands open as the story advances, and their windows may close with progress, so begin this character’s chain as soon as it appears and finish it before pushing deep into later chapters. Track the chain from its first contact; the eight completed strands also contribute to Strangers & Freaks. Roadmap stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start the character’s chain as soon as its marker appears.
Complete each mission in the chain in order.
Finish it before advancing deep into later chapters.
For Strangers & Freaks, repeat until eight strands are complete.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: This is the only confirmed missable: do the balcony lesson with Lucia the morning after Down to Earth, in Chapter 1, and finish all 18 spot meditations before leaving that chapter. The lesson adds one to the count but is not marked as a spot; its necessity is unconfirmed, so accept it as the safe route, then have Jason and Lucia meditate at each spot because each character counts separately. Roadmap stage 1 — Chapter 1 and the one missable.
steps: In Chapter 1, follow Lucia to the balcony the morning after Down to Earth.
Accept the lesson and let Lucia teach you; keep this safe +1 even though it is not a marked spot.
Before Chapter 1 ends, visit all 10 meditation locations.
Meditate with Jason and Lucia at every spot to reach 18 sessions.
trophies.missableNote: Meditate at every spot before Chapter 1 ends; after that, the balcony session is gone for good.
